title: Machine-Learning-Based LOS Detection for 5G Signals with Applications in Airport Environments.
summary: XGBoost/SVM features from 5G signals detected LOS/NLOS conditions in simulated channel scenarios and in-lab measurements; the paper reports up to 100% accuracy on its measurement test data. This supports a lab engineering result, not airport deployment. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: Data-driven XGBoost, random forest and SVM classifiers use extracted features from 5G signals for LOS/NLOS detection.
